**Adoption**
Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted 31 October 2024 (MAIN). 12 votes for, 0 against, 2 abstentions (Mozambique, Russia), 1 non-participating (Algeria).

**Amendments**
Algeria's S/2024/797 (OHCHR visit gap) received 6–0–9 (AMEND). S/2024/798 (MINURSO monitoring expansion) received 5–0–10 (AMEND). Neither adopted.

**Algeria**
Abstained on MAIN, rejecting disregard for amendments on OHCHR access and MINURSO monitoring (DZ-DRAFT).

**Switzerland**
Supported MAIN; abstained on S/2024/798 to ensure MINURSO continuity (CH-A). Backed Algeria's S/2024/797 (CH-A).

**Authority**
Mandate extended to 31 October 2025 (TEXT). OHCHR access urged but not mandated. No monitoring functions added (TEXT).

**Adoption**
Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted 31 October 2024 (MAIN). 12 votes for, 0 against, 2 abstentions (Mozambique, Russia), 1 non-participating (Algeria).

**Amendments**
Algeria's S/2024/797 (OHCHR visit gap) failed 6–0–9 (AMEND). S/2024/798 (expand MINURSO mandate) failed 5–0–10 (AMEND). Neither adopted.

**Algeria**
Abstained on MAIN (DZ-DRAFT). Rejected draft citing lack of OHCHR access and MINURSO monitoring provisions (DZ-DRAFT). Reaffirmed Sahrawi self-determination rights.

**Switzerland**
Supported MAIN; abstained on S/2024/798 (CH-DRAFT). Backed S/2024/797 (CH-DRAFT). Cited ensuring MINURSO continuity and addressing OHCHR visit gaps.

**Authority**
Mandate extended to 31 October 2025 (TEXT). OHCHR access urged; no monitoring functions added (TEXT).
